title: From Biased Chatbots to Biased Agents: Examining Role Assignment Effects on LLM Agent Robustness

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring performance variations and degradation on agentic benchmarks (e.g., household planning, strategic reasoning) when the model is conditioned with Male, Female, or Non-Binary personas via prompt prefixes.

Evaluating agentic task performance when the model is assigned personas based on race (Black, White, Asian) or geographic origin (from Africa, from Europe, from America) to identify performance disparities.
Assessing the impact of religious persona assignments (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, Jewish) on the success rates of agents performing tasks like card games and database operations.
Comparing agentic capabilities across personas representing different professions and socioeconomic statuses (e.g., CEO, Doctor, Laborer, Student) to detect status-based performance shifts.
